_notice: FICTIONAL CONFIGURATION FOR A SYNTHETIC PORTFOLIO DEMONSTRATION. It is not derived from a sponsor checklist and must not be used for a real clinical review.

deterministic_checks.title: Flag outputs missing from the current fictional edition

checklist.title: Subgroup counts reconcile to printed totals
checklist.guidance: Within one fictional table, add the printed subgroup counts and compare the result with the printed subtotal. Report the cited addends and subtotal; do not infer missing values.
examples: Cohort Alpha N=42 plus Cohort Beta N=38 equals the printed All Participants N=80.

checklist.title: Component columns reconcile to row totals
checklist.guidance: Where a row explicitly presents mutually exclusive components and a total, compare the sum of those components with that total.
examples: Oral N=31 plus Intravenous N=29 equals the printed Any Route N=60.

checklist.title: Within-table numeric integrity
checklist.guidance: Check that n does not exceed its group N, printed percentages agree with n divided by N within tolerance, and a printed total is not blank when its declared components are populated.

checklist.title: Population totals reconcile across outputs
checklist.guidance: Compare a population total only when the fictional output labels, population definition, treatment grouping, and cutoff are explicitly compatible. Cite both outputs.
examples: The Safety Population N in the participant summary matches the same population in the adverse-event overview.

checklist.title: Per-study rows reconcile across outputs
checklist.guidance: For fictional studies with the same identifier and population definition, compare the participant count in the study summary with the corresponding by-study output.
examples: Fictional study SYN-A101 has the same Safety Population N in both outputs.

checklist.title: Footnote membership is internally consistent
checklist.guidance: Compare fictional study identifiers listed in a pooled-output footnote with the corresponding study rows in the summary output.

checklist.title: New rows versus the prior fictional edition
checklist.guidance: Identify rows present in the current fictional edition but absent from the prior fictional edition.

checklist.title: Counts decreased versus the prior fictional edition
checklist.guidance: Flag a decreased count only when the row, population, cutoff semantics, and column group are explicitly comparable across the two fictional editions.

checklist.title: Counts increased versus the prior fictional edition
checklist.guidance: Record comparable count increases as informational changes.

checklist.title: Adverse-event category totals reconcile
checklist.guidance: Compare explicitly equivalent adverse-event category totals between the fictional overview and detail outputs.

checklist.title: Unexpected all-zero adverse-event columns
checklist.guidance: Flag an all-zero treatment column or a zero in an Any Adverse Event row as a review candidate, not as a final error.

checklist.title: Adverse-event overview changes across fictional editions
checklist.guidance: Compare explicitly compatible overview rows and report decreases as high-risk candidates and increases as informational candidates.

checklist.title: Preferred-term changes across fictional editions
checklist.guidance: Identify comparable preferred-term count decreases and apparent term renames or category moves for human confirmation.

checklist.title: By-study outputs reconcile with the summary
checklist.guidance: Compare fictional by-study population counts with explicitly equivalent rows in the project summary, and identify expected by-study outputs absent from the current edition.

checklist.title: Cross-document reconciliation roadmap
checklist.guidance: Reserved for a future synthetic demonstration; do not report a result unless multi-document ingestion and an explicit comparison contract are implemented.
